name: modular-research
description: Modular research task: brief in, PDF + podcast out. Takes a (dictated) brief through a GitHub repo as research notebook, parallel-subagent research with a source log, a Typst PDF report and a two-host educational podcast (Gemini TTS), then Google Drive and email. Every output module is optional and runs alone; the repo can stay a one-off or keep growing in follow-up rounds. A research-report skill does the same research inside an existing project repo and produces a timestamped, agent-attributed executive report PDF.
